q: Poincaré duality for a closed oriented n-manifold M gives a natural isomorphism:
opts: H^k(M;ℤ) ≅ H_{n-k}(M;ℤ) (cohomology in degree k ↔ homology in degree n-k)
exp: Poincaré duality: for a closed oriented n-manifold, [M] ∩ ·: H^k(M) → H_{n-k}(M) is an isomorphism (cap product with the fundamental class). Over ℤ, one must account for Ext/Tor corrections. Over a field, H^k(M;k) ≅ H_{n-k}(M;k).
